audit.summary: Theorem4.3 and the orbit-closure input imply Theorem1.3 with the printed normalization and support quantifiers. The simultaneous fixed cutoff, adjoint/product norm identity, exact residual cancellation, spatial pushforward and dimensional interpretation are checked. No substantive Problem is established. Full Ratner, FUP, anisotropic-calculus and Fourier-integral estimates remain inputs.
limitations: Limits: Only the exact acquired arXiv v2 author manuscript is assessed; no journal-final equivalence is established.
Limits: The conditional deduction is not exhaustive proof certification of Theorems3.3 or4.3 or the entire paper.
Limits: External Ratner/Shah theory, the full long-word estimate, microlocal calculus and FUP remain declared inputs.
Limits: Universal full support remains a separate conjecture; no quantum unique ergodicity or positive lower-dimensional mass statement is derived.
Limits: The dimension-one paragraph is a conditional geometric interpretation, not a new analytic surface theorem.
Limits: Optional code and supplements were not found in a bounded historical acquisition search; that is neither universal absence nor a mathematical defect.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
